 Hyderabad Top News Hyderabad Weather Today, October 21: IMD Forecasts Partly Cloudy Skies
 Subhransu Satpathy 21 Oct 2026 5:12 PM Share this: HYDERABAD: Hyderabad is likely to experience partly cloudy weather and hazy conditions during the morning hours on Wednesday, October 21, according to the India Meteorological Department (IMD). The maximum and minimum temperatures are expected to remain around 34°C and 23°C, respectively.
 The IMD has forecast light to moderate rain or thundershowers at isolated places across Telangana on October 21. Thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds of 30–40 kmph are likely in six districts: Bhadradri Kothagudem, Khammam, Nalgonda, Suryapet, Mahbubnagar and Nagarkurnool. 
 However, the Hyderabad zone-wise forecast classifies the expected weather impact as very low across all 12 zones from October 21 to 25. The bulletin does not indicate a separate yellow or orange alert for Hyderabad city.
 HYDERABAD: 108 ambulances launch eye emergency care pilot
 Hyderabad weather today: Will it rain on October 21?
 The IMD has forecast partly cloudy skies in Hyderabad, with haze likely during the morning hours. Easterly surface winds are expected at speeds of 4–8 kmph.
 The city’s forecast maximum temperature is around 34°C, while the minimum is expected to be approximately 23°C. The latest observation recorded a maximum of 33.8°C and a minimum of 22.8°C, with 67% relative humidity and no rainfall reported in the bulletin. 
 Rain or thundershowers are possible at isolated places across Telangana. However, the supplied Hyderabad city forecast does not specifically predict rainfall in the city.
 The IMD has assessed the weather impact as very low in Uppal, LB Nagar, Khairatabad, Golconda, Rajendranagar, Charminar, Serilingampally, Kukatpally, Secunderabad, Malkajgiri, Shamshabad and Quthbullapur.
 Hyderabad weather tomorrow: Forecast for October 22
 Hyderabad is likely to continue experiencing partly cloudy skies and morning haze on Thursday, October 22. The IMD expects temperatures to remain around 34°C during the day and 23°C at night.
 Across Telangana, dry weather is very likely to prevail from the morning of October 22 through October 23. The supplied bulletin lists no weather warning for October 22.
 Residents should note that the statewide forecast does not rule out every possibility of local weather variation. The IMD’s published outlook, however, favours dry conditions.
 Hyderabad weather forecast: Next five days
 The IMD’s zone-wise forecast gives the same outlook for all 12 Hyderabad zones for October 21–25.
 Date Hyderabad forecast Expected impact 
 October 21 Partly cloudy; morning haze likely Very low 
 October 22 Partly cloudy; morning haze likely Very low 
 October 23 Partly cloudy; morning haze likely Very low 
 October 24 Partly cloudy; morning haze likely Very low 
 October 25 Partly cloudy; morning haze likely Very low 
 The zone-wise bulletin does not forecast rainfall separately for individual Hyderabad zones during this period. Morning haze is the main recurring feature in the city forecast.
 Telangana weather today: Six districts face thunderstorm warning
 The IMD has forecast thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds of 30–40 kmph at isolated places in six Telangana districts on October 21.
 The districts are:
 Bhadradri Kothagudem
 Khammam
 Nalgonda
 Suryapet
 Mahbubnagar
 Nagarkurnool
 The bulletin’s warning section contains a date inconsistency: its seven-day forecast table associates the district-specific yellow warning with October 20, while the seven-day forecast issued on October 21 places the thunderstorm outlook within the October 21 forecast period. The district list is reproduced from the supplied bulletin, but the exact warning date should be checked against the original IMD warning before publication.
 The statewide outlook indicates dry weather from October 22 to 26. Isolated light to moderate rain or thundershowers may return on October 27, with thunderstorms, lightning and gusty winds of 30–40 kmph forecast at isolated places in Telangana in the later forecast period. The bulletin’s day labels for this final warning also differ slightly between sections.
 IMD advisory: Safety precautions during thunderstorms
 Although Hyderabad’s zone-wise weather impact is rated very low, thunderstorms are forecast in parts of Telangana. Residents in affected districts should take precautions if lightning or gusty winds develop.
 Move indoors to a substantial building when thunderstorm activity begins.
 Avoid standing under trees, particularly isolated trees, during lightning.
 Stay away from weak walls and unsecured outdoor structures.
 Secure loose items that strong gusts could displace.
 Use caution on wet or slippery roads if rain occurs.
 The IMD has not forecast heavy rainfall for Hyderabad in the supplied city bulletin. The thunderstorm warning should not be interpreted as a heavy-rain alert.
 Why is Telangana experiencing this weather?
 According to the IMD’s October 21 press release, a low-pressure area formed over the southwest Bay of Bengal and adjoining Tamil Nadu coast at 5.30 am and persisted in the same region at 8.30 am. The associated cyclonic circulation extended up to 5.8 km above mean sea level.
 The IMD also reported a cyclonic circulation over the Gulf of Thailand and adjoining Thailand and Myanmar. It was expected to move into the North Andaman Sea and could help trigger another low-pressure area over the southeast and adjoining east-central Bay of Bengal around October 23. The system was forecast to move northwestwards and intensify over the following three days.
 The bulletin does not establish that these systems will bring rain to Hyderabad during the next five days.
